answer: An copycat thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 49 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The beacon counter is kept in ferrous and lotus shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 49 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4499 identities would post 4425 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
